root_idea.summary: The root denotes night as the temporal counterpart of day, with لَيْل referring generally to night and لَيْلَة to an individual or designated night.
root_idea.development: The lexical family distinguishes the general night-period from a counted or specified night and its plural forms, including لَيَالٍ and لَيْلَاتٌ.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized noun لَيْل.
The T-tagged occurrences are temporal or adverbial uses of the same noun لَيْل, not a separate lexical headword.
Displayed under the normalized noun لَيْلَة.
The T-tagged occurrence is an adverbial use of the same noun لَيْلَة, not a separate lexical headword.

senses.definition: Night; the period opposed to daytime.
senses.usage_conditions: Used as a temporal noun, including prepositional and adverbial constructions meaning by, in, or at night. Its plural forms include لَيَالٍ and لَيْلَاتٌ; these are grammatical variants of the same lexical branch.

senses.definition: A single, counted, or specifically designated night.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an individual night or a night identified by an event or designation, including a specified number of nights and the Night of Decree. Its plural forms include لَيَالٍ and لَيْلَاتٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression بَنَاتُ اللَّيْلِ, wishes and anxieties.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic plural expression rather than a separate basic meaning of لَيْل.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression ابْنُ اللَّيْلِ, a thief or robber.
In the expression ابْنُ اللَّيْلِ, a wayfarer or traveller.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic expression with a distinct sense from the use meaning thief or robber.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression أَخُو اللَّيْلِ, a nightfarer.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional idiomatic designation for one who travels by night.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A night-journey or a journey made at night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized conventional use of لَيْلَة, distinct from its ordinary meaning ‘a night’.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Used adverbially to refer to a particular night, such as ‘tonight’ or ‘last night’, according to context.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Occurs in temporal expressions with the accusative form لَيْلَةَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Wine; in this expression, لَيْلَى signifies intoxication or ecstasy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized idiomatic expression, not a general meaning of لَيْل or لَيْلَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A night-by-night arrangement or practice, analogous to a daily or monthly arrangement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived verbal noun formed from the notion of night; it is not a synonym for the basic noun ‘night’.
